Players Committee card image of [[Stalker (V)]] (original printing), game text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. If opponent's starship just moved from here, Stalker may follow it as a regular move (if within range).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
